messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — HIGH severity: sudden spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts observed across inference-gateway-prod (route /v1/generate). Metric: 5xx rate up 18x over baseline in last 3m. Pager duty: on-call eng team paged.

mike: saw the spike on the dashboard, paging now. can someone confirm customer-facing impact?

sara: yes CS reports multiple customer errors, some long tail timeouts. started digging into envoy logs — lots of upstream reset+502s from lb-backend-pool-3.

julia: throwing up top-level graphs: latency p95 from 180ms -> 2.4s, concurrent 503s rising. no recent deploys to inference-gateway in last 30m.

ash: I'm oncall, joining. @mike @sara what's current suspicion? route-level retry policy changed last night?

mike: we rolled a global retry policy change for shadow traffic earlier (lowered per-try timeout) but it was shadow only. however last config sync to envoy clusters applied at 08:12 which touched route retry budget in prod.

sara: grabbing envoy admin logs now: repeated entries like: "upstream reset: stream reset" and "no healthy upstream" for service model-service-v2. Also sees: "retries exhausted, responding 502".

kevin: digging into LB: route weight for model-service-v2 pool shows zeroed weights on some shards (weird). I'm checking control-plane config history.

julia: customer impact: 4 customers with high error rates; one enterprise (acct: acme-corp) experiencing >30% request failures. CS opened a ticket.

oncall-ops: escalation checklist — notify infra, consider disabling retries at proxy layer, scale up pool, reduce weight to problematic shards, roll back most recent config.

ash: immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable route retries for /v1/generate to stop amplification 2) reduce weight to 0 for pool lb-backend-pool-3 which shows unhealthy heatmap 3) increase circuit-breaker limits temporarily to avoid early ejects 4) open canary fallback to model-service-v1 variant. doing 1 and 2 now.

mike: deployed a hotpatch to route config via control-plane: set retry_on: none and retry_budget: 0 for /v1/generate route. applying now.

sara: applied, envoy hot-reload successful on 57/60 proxies, 3 still reloading. logs show retries dropped; immediate 5xx rate dropping from 18x -> 6x in 90s.

kevin: reduced weight on lb-backend-pool-3 to 0 for region-us-east-1. traffic shifted to pool-1/2. circuit breaker settings changed: max_connections +50%, max_pending + 200.

julia: monitoring: error rate continues to fall, now 2x baseline. p95 back to 300-400ms. acme-corp still seeing intermittent errors but seriously improved.

ash: follow-ups — keep retries disabled for 30m, collect traces for failed requests, avoid rolling the full config until root cause is known. we should prepare rollback if errors rise.

mike: collecting request ids and traces: example trace ids: trace-9f7a, trace-afe3, shows upstream resets with ECONNRESET on backend. forwarding to infra.

sara: hypothesis: a misapplied route weight / shard assignment combined with retry amplification caused backend overload resulting in upstream resets and CB ejections. will verify control-plane audit logs for config push at 08:12.

kevin: found control-plane diff: an automated job inadvertently included a heuristic that zeroed weights for healthy pods when over-threshold CPU; the job had a bug that didn't check for zero-weight safety. that change hit prod at 08:11 and the config sync at 08:12.

julia: root cause candidate confirmed. next steps: patch autoscaler job to never zero a pool without upstream fallback, add a safety guard in control-plane, and re-enable retries only after stabilization and testing.

oncall-ops: action items: 
- ash: follow up with infra to validate backend health and do postmortem blameless timeline.
- mike: gather traces + customer impact summary for acme-corp and other affected customers.
- kevin: patch control-plane job and propose CI gate preventing zeroing weights.
- sara: run regression test for retry behavior against a canary cluster.

mike: notifying CS + SRE escalation. marking incident as mitigated (errors down to near-normal) but will keep paging active for 2h watch. :white_check_mark:

julia: logging the timeline and saving config diffs to the incident ticket. thanks all.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigated -> watch. participants: 7. severity: HIGH->DEGRADED. incident channel pinned for postmortem notes.
